mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pen carriage onto the guides was the most worthwhile step: it brought the pen and rover together into a recognizable drawing mechanism.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two separate guard fittings felt somewhat repetitive in the text interface, although each visibly covered a different wheel box.

surprise.text: The return spring surrounded a guide rod beside the pen; I had not been certain exactly where it would go.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the current goals identified each fitting and the results showed where it went.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another construction, though the predictable individual fittings were less engaging in text. This experience does not establish how the pictures or physical handling would feel.
